paite: Ngai in, TOUPA' lei a-awngsak in asesak ding a, alumlet ding a, a-omte adalhsak ding hi.
heading: Toupa'n Leitung Asawi Ding
english: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

paite: Huan vantang tung a om bang in siampu tung ah leng a-om ding; sikhapa tung a om bang in apu tung ah leng a-om ding; sikhanu tung a om bang in api tung ah leng a-om ding; aleimi tung a om bang in, akhawngmi tung ah leng a-om ding; leitawisakmi tung a om bang in, leitawimi tung ah leng a-om ding; apung delh a leitawisakmi tung a om bang in, akiang a apung pemi tung ah leng a-om ding.
english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

paite: Leitung awnsak keuhkeuh in leh hihsiat dimdem in a-om ding; TOUPA'N achita hi.
english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.

paite: Leitung akap in atul a, khovel abah in atul a, leitung a mi tungnungte abah uhi.
english: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

paite: A-om mite nuai ah leitung abuah khinta; dante ah atalek ua, thupiakte hihlamdang a, tangtawn thukhun a atatlek ziak un.
english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

paite: Huaiziak in hamsiat in leitung ane khin a, a-om mite lah siam louh tansak in a-omta uh; huaiziak in lei a om mite lah akanglum ua, mi tawmchik kia a-om lai uh.
english: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

paite: Uain thak akap a, grepgui abah a, lungtang nuamte tengteng amau uhi.
english: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

paite: Khuangtate kipahna adai a, kaihging nuamsa ging adaita.
english: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

paite: Lasa kawm in uain adawn kei ding uh; adawn mite a ding in zu akha mahmah ding.
english: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

paite: Buaina khopi chipsak in a-omta; kuamah alutlouhna ding un inn chih khak in a-omta.
english: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

paite: Uain ziak in kongzingte ah kah husa a-om a; nopna tengteng mialsak in a-om a, hiai gam nopna amangta.
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

paite: Khopi ah siatna nutsiat in a-om a, akulh kongkhak vuaksiat in a-omta.
english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

paite: Lei laitak ah michih lak ah huchi in a-om ding hi, olive sing vuak nung a gah a-om lai bang in leh grep loh nung a maih khak grep loh ding a-om lai bang in.
english: For it will be so in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

paite: Huaite'n a-aw uh asuah ding ua, akikou ding uh; TOUPA thupina ziak in tuipi a kipan in ngaihtak in akikou ding uh.
english: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA tuh Suahlam ah pahtawi un. TOUPA, Israel' Pathian min mahmah, tuipi tuikulh gamte ah pahtawi un.
english: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

paite: Kawlmong tawp a lasak i za, Midiktatte kiang ah thupina om hen, chih la. Himahleh, ke'n bel, "Ka gawng huaihuai a, ka gawng huaihuai a, ka tung agik hi! Lepchiahtak a gamta mite'n lepchiahtak in thil ahih ua; ahi, lepchiahtak a gamta mite'n lepchiahtak in ahih uhi, ka chi hi.
english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

paite: Leitung a tengte aw, lauhuainate, kokhukte, thangte na tung ah a-om hi.
english: Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabitant the earth.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, lauhuai husa a kipan a taipa kokhuk ah ake ding a; kokhuk sung a kipan a pawtkhetoumi thang ah a-awk ding; tunglam a tohlette lah hon in a-om ngal a, lei kingaknate aling hi.
english: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the midst of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

paite: Leitung akitamgawp vek a, leitung hihman in a-om vek a, nakpitak in leitung aling hi.
english: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

paite: Mi zukham bang in leitung ahoi dongdong ding a, biakbuk hawt bang in akihot ding; atatlekna lah atung ah giktak in a-om ding a, huchi in apuk ding a, athounawnta kei ding hi.
english: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

paite: "Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N tunglam a mi tungnung pawl lian pipite a gawt ding, leitung a leitung kumpipate toh.
english: It shall happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

paite: Hentate kokhuk a pikhawm a a-om bang un huaite pikhawm in a-om ding ua, suangkul a khum in a-om ding uh, ni sawttak nung in gawt in a-om ding uh.
english: They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.

paite: Huai hun chiang in tung a khapi zumtak in a-om ding a, tung a nisa zahlaktak in a-om ding; sepaihte TOUPA lah Zion tang leh Jerusalem ah leh a-upate ma ah, thupitak a kumpi a om ding ahi ngal a."
english: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders will be glory.
